headline: Get Bulbly
title: How to Get Bulbly | Tideblossom Coast Lightning Support | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Bulbly is a Lightning support Aniimo, and it lives on Tideblossom Coast. Wild ones sit around level fifty three to sixty, so come with a strong team. It evolves into Veilfloat at level forty two, and Veilfloat becomes Luminelle at level fifty two. Its Arc Surge trait shares a Lightning boost with teammates. It is an easy catch for a late game team. Do you plan to hunt a Bulbly? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Bulbly is a Lightning support found on Tideblossom Coast at wild levels 53 to 60. It evolves into Veilfloat at level 42 and then Luminelle at level 52.
